description: Edit anchor points of paths: remove them without splitting the path (Object > Path > Remove Anchor Points), convert them to corner points (handles retracted) or smooth points (handles aligned; retracted handles are pulled out a third of the way to the neighbouring anchors), or set one point's anchor and handles. Choose points by index (from get_path_info) on one path, or the anchors selected with the Direct Selection tool

action.description: remove, corner, smooth, or set (one point: anchor and handles)

anchor.description: set: new anchor [x, y]. Its handles move with it unless given

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

leftHandle.description: set: the handle towards the previous anchor, [x, y]

points.description: 0-based anchor indexes on the one target path

rightHandle.description: set: the handle towards the next anchor, [x, y]

selectedPoints.description: Act on the anchors selected with the Direct Selection tool instead of indexes

target.description: Paths, compound paths or groups. With points, exactly one path

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: edit_anchor_points
title: Edit Anchor Points
